svg.data-psu-redundancy: two internal supplies, AC or DC
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 50 C; -40 to 65 C for the TMC-3312SCH
svg.data-services: MEF CE 2.0 E-LINE, E-LAN, E-TREE, E-ACCESS; 802.1Q, 802.1ad; MPLS VPWS, VPLS, H-VPLS
svg.data-ces: 8 x T1/E1 circuit emulation for 2G/3G and TDM migration
svg.data-timing: SyncE, adaptive clocking; BITS in/out on the SCH version
svg.data-resiliency: sub-50 ms G.8032 R-APS, STP/RSTP/MSTP, FRR, H-VPLS dual homing, LAG, BFD, redundant power
svg.data-local: CON RS-232 ASCII console and ETH out-of-band Ethernet on RJ45
